svg.title: Cistern Works — Three marked cistern valves
svg.desc: Parallel freshwater channels sit below a continuous maintenance gallery. Three symbol valves, tool benches and counterweight baskets form the inspection loop. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Parallel freshwater channels sit below a continuous maintenance gallery. Three symbol
